title: Private deployment intake & triage: networking, upgrade, air-gapped constraints
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Customer intake and prioritization for multiple enterprise requests related to Private/VPC/on-prem deployments where the primary constraints are restricted networking (no outbound Internet), controlled upgrade windows, and strict air-gapped/security requirements. Incoming asks include: (1) automated offline upgrade playbook for air-gapped clusters, (2) explicit network allowlist and proxy config guidance for on-prem installers, (3) documented KMS/HSM integration patterns for customer-managed keys, and (4) fallback/rollback procedures when agents cannot access Redwood control plane. Objective: triage requests, assign engineering scope, and deliver an operationally safe, auditable runbook + product options that meet enterprise SLAs.
acceptance_criteria: Create a prioritized intake matrix that scores requests by customer risk, revenue, compliance need, and engineering scoped effort
Publish a draft offline upgrade playbook (air-gapped) with step-by-step commands and verification checks in Confluence
Produce a networking checklist (ports, DNS, proxy, allowlist, NAT recommendations) for on-prem installs and VPC peering scenarios
Agree on minimal viable HSM/KMS flow and document required APIs and customer responsibilities
Plan an initial pilot with one enterprise customer and schedule rollout dates and rollback runbook review with Security and SRE
proposed_solution: Adopt a two-track approach: short-term product docs + scripted playbooks for immediate customer onboarding, and medium-term product changes (installer improvements, offline image signer, control-plane proxy mode). Short-term deliverables include Confluence playbook, a network checklist, and pre-approved SRE runbook. Medium-term work will be scoped as ENG stories: offline-upgrade-controller, signed-artifact-distribution, and proxy-gateway for control-plane operations.
